channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — A-Level
channel.description: A-Level revision notes for Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Science.

item.title: Wave Properties
item.description: Key definitions of wave properties including amplitude, wavelength, frequency, period, and wave speed. Understanding transverse and longitudinal waves with worked examples.

item.title: Superposition and Interference
item.description: The principle of superposition, constructive and destructive interference, Young's double slit experiment, and diffraction gratings with calculations.

item.title: Refraction and Total Internal Reflection
item.description: Snell's law, critical angle calculations, total internal reflection applications, and fibre optics. Worked examples and common exam questions.

item.title: A-Level Physics — Waves Complete Guide
item.description: Complete A-Level Physics waves topic covering wave properties, superposition, interference, diffraction, refraction, and total internal reflection.

item.title: Research Methods in Psychology
item.description: A-Level Psychology research methods including experiments, observations, correlations, self-report techniques, and reliability and validity concepts.

item.title: Social Influence
item.description: Conformity, obedience, and compliance. Asch's line study, Milgram's obedience experiment, and Zimbardo's Stanford prison experiment.

item.title: Memory
item.description: Multi-store model, working memory model, types of long-term memory, and factors affecting forgetting including interference and retrieval failure.

item.title: Attachment
item.description: Learning theory of attachment, Harlow's monkeys, Bowlby's monotropic theory, and Ainsworth's Strange Situation. Cultural variations in attachment.

item.title: Psychopathology
item.description: Definitions of abnormality, characteristics of phobias, depression, and OCD. Behavioural, cognitive, and psychodynamic explanations.

item.title: Approaches in Psychology
item.description: Origins of psychology including behaviourist, psychodynamic, humanistic, cognitive, biological, and social learning theory approaches.

item.title: Biopsychology
item.description: The nervous system, the endocrine system, fight or flight response, localisation of brain function, and split brain research.

item.title: Issues and Debates in Psychology
item.description: Gender and culture in psychology, free will and determinism, the nature-nurture debate, holism and reductionism, and ethical implications of research.

item.title: A-Level Mathematics — Pure Mathematics
item.description: Complete A-Level Pure Mathematics notes covering algebra, calculus, trigonometry, sequences, and proof with worked examples and exam-style questions.

item.title: A-Level Revision Notes — Complete Guide
item.description: 366 pages of A-Level revision notes for Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Psychology, Economics, English, Geography, and History.
